headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of August 18, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 24.12% compared to SPY's 13.24%. This 10.88% average alpha indicates that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A,' has achieved a remarkable return of 47.50%, contributing significantly to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B,' has returned 12.74%, highlighting a notable disparity within the group. Outperforming SPY during this period can signal resilience amid broader market conditions. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
